title: Pink Pony Club
subtitle: Chappell Roan
description: A glittery, anthemic pop track about a girl who dreams of escaping her small town to dance in a big-city gay bar. Chappell Roan's breakout moment — bold, campy, and completely unforgettable.

title: drop dead
subtitle: Olivia Rodrigo
description: A brooding, distorted pop-rock number from GUTS. Raw, sarcastic, and dripping with teenage fury — exactly what you'd expect from Rodrigo at her most unfiltered.

title: Cruel Summer
subtitle: Taylor Swift
description: Originally buried as a deep cut on Lover, Cruel Summer became a phenomenon years later. A synth-pop rush of summer tension, secret love, and screaming confessions.

title: because i liked a boy
subtitle: Sabrina Carpenter
description: A wry, self-aware pop track where Carpenter catalogues the absurd social fallout of liking a boy. Delivered with a wink and impeccable vocal control.

title: Good 4 U
subtitle: Olivia Rodrigo
description: A pop-punk explosion of jealousy and fake well-wishing. Good 4 U captures the messy, irrational anger of watching an ex move on perfectly fine without you.

title: Espresso
subtitle: Sabrina Carpenter
description: Light, breezy, and impossibly catchy. Espresso is the summer earworm that turned Sabrina Carpenter into a household name — all confidence and effortless cool.

title: Casual
subtitle: Chappell Roan
description: A quieter, more vulnerable side of Chappell Roan. Casual aches with the confusion of a relationship that refuses to be defined — tender and strangely heavy.

meta.value: The Rise and Fall of a Midwest Princess

title: vampire
subtitle: Olivia Rodrigo
description: A sweeping, piano-driven ballad that builds into something almost orchestral. Rodrigo weaponises a classic metaphor — the charming emotional predator — with surgical precision.

title: Ribs
subtitle: Lorde
description: A haunting, synth-layered track from Pure Heroine that captures the specific anxiety of growing up — of having a body and a life that feels too big and too fast to hold.

title: Solar Power
subtitle: Lorde
description: Languid and sun-drenched, Solar Power is Lorde shedding intensity for something looser and more pastoral. A divisive pivot, but undeniably beautiful in its softness.

title: drivers license
subtitle: Olivia Rodrigo
description: The debut that changed everything. Drivers license arrived like a thunderclap — confessional, devastating, and inescapable. A modern breakup classic.

title: Die For You
subtitle: The Weeknd
description: Originally from Starboy, Die For You found new life years later. A slow-burn declaration of devotion wrapped in gleaming synths and falsetto — The Weeknd at his most romantic.

title: Blinding Lights
subtitle: The Weeknd
description: A retro-synth juggernaut that dominated the charts for what felt like an eternity. Blinding Lights distils 80s nostalgia into something urgent and modern.

title: Motion Sickness
subtitle: Phoebe Bridgers
description: Biting and precise, Motion Sickness is Phoebe Bridgers unravelling a toxic relationship with devastating calm. The acoustic softness makes it hit harder, not easier.

title: Vienna
subtitle: Billy Joel
description: A timeless reminder to slow down. Vienna tells a young, overachieving generation that there's time — that rushing toward some imagined finish line misses the whole point of living.
